verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the Simba ODBC and JDBC drivers for BigQuery, which connect applications to BigQuery so users can work with their preferred tooling. That covers the standard-driver part of the story. Community posts confirm a Google Sheets integration backed by BigQuery data, but no named BI-tool connector documentation appears in the pack. Missing for 10: documented integrations with mainstream BI/dashboard tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, Power BI), and hands-on corroboration that dashboards connect through the drivers without custom glue.
